testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-product-details-after-reorder-from-existing-order-via-history.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify product details after reorder from existing order via history

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in, empties the cart, opens Order History and reorders an existing order whose line is a configurable product with three add-ons (checkbox, drop-down, radio) and a personalization; the cart shows that product with its name, add-ons, personalization, SKU, unit price, quantity and row total. The cart is emptied and the user logs out; the order is only read.
steps: Empty storage state: open the login page, sign in with the declared account, empty the cart
Open Order History, read the rows (at least one), click Reorder on the first (most recent) row
Open the cart and wait for 1 line item
Find the line by product name; check name, add-ons block (Checkbox, Select Add-on, Radio), personalization block (Anniversary Gift), SKU, unit cost, quantity and row total = price x quantity
Remove all items, check the empty-cart message, log out and check the sign-in link
stateChanges: The signed-in user's cart: emptied, filled by the reorder, emptied again
The existing order is only read (reorder copies it to the cart); no order is placed
assertions: Order History has at least one row
Cart line for the product name is present and shows the name
Add-ons block of the line SKU contains 'Checkbox : <addOnCheckBox>', 'Select Add-on : <addOnDropDown>', 'Radio : <addOnRadio>'
Personalization block of the line SKU contains 'Anniversary Gift : <personalizableText>'
SKU text is 'SKU: <sku>'; unit cost contains price; quantity input equals quantity; row total close to price x quantity
Empty cart message after removal; sign-in link visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify product details after reorder from existing order via history'; step 3 title says 'the reordered configurable product'
Spec comment: relies on a seeded order in the dedicated account's history (AT Stage backup DB); user decision: the order is FOUND read-only on the declared account, never created

OWNERSHIP (core 0.13.0, 2026-11-01): the order must belong to the signed-in (declared) account. Need order links owner to @user.userId (ORDER_OF_USER_REORDERABLE: ZnodeOrder.UserId = @owner), so it resolves at test start when the test declares the account (testData.useExisting); strategy stays migrate

The test reorders rows[0] (the most recent order of the account), not a named order: the migrated test must click Reorder for the resolved order's orderNumber (order history row id = order number), or another order of the same account (e.g. one placed by the receipt-and-history test) is reordered instead

Profile: PinkApple is an active published product (inventory 4999836, storefrontProductIndex 1, requiredAddOnCount 1) stored as SimpleProduct: it is the variant SKU of a configurable parent (cart test-ids divConfigurableProductAddons<sku> / divConfigurableProductPersonalization<sku> are keyed by the variant SKU), so productType 'configurable' is the ordered type; the query must match it on the parent product (lineParentProductType), not on the line's own PIM type
minAddOns 3: three add-on groups asserted (checkbox, drop-down, radio); profile finds all three add-on products (RegUi_SimpleProd, the Lutron switch, the DeWalt sander kit) active with inventory
minPersonalizableAttributes 1: one personalization asserted ('Anniversary Gift'); the personalization text lives in ZnodeOrderProduct.Customization, a masked column in the order entity map

Add-on group labels 'Checkbox', 'Select Add-on', 'Radio' and the personalization label 'Anniversary Gift' are literals inside the spec's template strings (not scanned values): they are the resolved order's add-on group and personalization attribute names and must come from the resolved record in the migrated test
quantity 1 is the ordered line quantity (reorder copies it): role data of the order; quantityUsed 1
price $509.25 is the current unit price incl. add-ons shown in the cart: expected-output, computed from the resolved line, not the order total
Fact from the user: this spec PASSES on atstage unmigrated

Outputs: orderNumber (click Reorder for it), sku, name (current PIM product name), quantity (ordered line quantity), addOn1..3Group/Name (the line's add-ons ordered by group name: Checkbox, Radio, Select Add-on on the seeded order). GAP: personalizableText and its label ('Anniversary Gift') live in the masked ZnodeOrderProduct.Customization, so no output carries them; the query only checks that the line is personalized (presence, at most 1)
